# Experiment E summary (generated by analyze_E.py)

Evaluation seed 111, 5,663,400 payments per law (113,268 blocks). The four policies replay the same paths on each law. Amounts are dollars per payment; bp is relative to the law's realized mean exposure. Intervals are 95% percentile intervals of a paired block bootstrap (1000 resamples, seed 20260930). The margin is 10 bp. Cutoff threshold pihat(0) = 0.255180, floor $1.90, v* $3.13. The exposure law samples the point masses of an on-chain histogram (amounts binned to 3 significant figures) by inverse transform and clips to [0.01, 2000].

Data: Public Dune table tokens.transfers, blockchain base, symbol USDC, tx_from in the facilitator address list of the public dashboard "x402 Facilitators" (Dune team). Amounts rounded to 3 significant figures and counted per amount; no addresses or recipients. Queried 2026-09-30.

## 6. Reading (spec sec 4, applied to the point estimate)

(L6) At L6 (all listed Base facilitators, last 90 days (from 2026-07-02); realized mean $0.4076), Comp - Cutoff = +640.48 bp (+2.610e-02 $ per payment), 95% interval [+497.88, +790.51] bp; the point estimate is outside the 10 bp margin. By the rule, report the size and the share from payments above v*. The difference is +640.48 bp, of which the share from payments above v* is 100.0%. The interval does not lie inside the margin. Payments above v* ($3.13) are 1.087% of the count and 81.88% of the value (above the floor $1.90: 1.729% of the count, 86.01% of the value). Limits of the data: one facilitator list (a curated list), one chain (Base), a 90-day window, amounts binned to 3 significant figures.

(L7) At L7 (Coinbase facilitator, its last 90 active days (2025-10-12 to 2026-01-09); realized mean $0.3972), Comp - Cutoff = +191.83 bp (+7.620e-03 $ per payment), 95% interval [+163.26, +225.06] bp; the point estimate is outside the 10 bp margin. By the rule, report the size and the share from payments above v*. The difference is +191.83 bp, of which the share from payments above v* is 98.8%. The interval does not lie inside the margin. Payments above v* ($3.13) are 0.265% of the count and 26.87% of the value (above the floor $1.90: 0.454% of the count, 27.86% of the value). Limits of the data: one facilitator (Coinbase), one chain (Base), a 90-day window that ends on 2026-01-09 (not recent data), amounts binned to 3 significant figures.
